title: OpenOKR: the §13.1 budgets
description: The TECHNICAL-PLAN §13.1 rows this instance can measure from its own series. The six that need a browser or a channel are charted by pnpm perf:budgets and the P7-T05 suites instead, and are named in the text panel below rather than left silently absent.

panels.title: Save actions, 95th percentile (budget 500 ms)
panels.description: Every write the registry declares as `write` or `destructive`, which is what §13.1 means by a save.

panels.title: Slowest actions, 95th percentile
panels.description: No budget of its own. This is where a §13.1 row that has not been given a panel yet shows up first.

panels.title: HTTP at the edge, by status class
panels.description: From Caddy, not from the application. `apps/web/proxy.ts` is synchronous and returns before the handler produces a status, so this is the only honest place to measure it.

panels.title: The six rows that are not on this dashboard, and why

options.content:
These §13.1 rows cannot be measured from a server-side metric, so they are charted by the tool that can rather than left silently absent.

| Row | Measured by |
|---|---|
| Work Map first paint and interactive | `pnpm perf:budgets`, and `e2e/s44-web-vitals.spec.ts` for the browser half |
| Work Map and list scroll at 60fps | `e2e/s44-web-vitals.spec.ts` |
| Draft Coach evaluation under 16 ms on the client | `e2e/s44-web-vitals.spec.ts` |
| Session stage transition to every client | `pnpm perf:load` (P7-T02) |
| Channel nudge delivery under 60 s | needs a real provider; `openokr_nudges_total` here shows what was sent and why |
| Core web vitals | `e2e/s44-web-vitals.spec.ts` |
